summary: The author describes quantizing model weights to ~4-bit to fit a language model under 20GB alongside its KV cache, perception encoder, and a 'dflash' drafter that proposes token blocks the main model verifies in parallel.

mechanisms.reason: Quantizing weights to ~4-bit and fitting the model under 20GB is a stated technique that reduces the memory and compute footprint required per token.
mechanisms.quote: to achieve maximum memory efficiency, we quantize model weights to ~4-bit, getting the language model under 20GB with room for the kv cache, perception encoder, and drafter alongside it

practices.reason: The post gives a concrete, reproducible recipe -- 4-bit quantization plus a speculative drafter verifying token blocks in parallel -- that an engineering team could implement to cut memory and latency costs.
